svg.title: A paused run resumes after peer instruction
svg.desc: Reuse the paused route and extend it toward the worker after the peer card arrives. Keep the unauthenticated marker visible at the crossing so influence cannot read as authorization.

**Frame:** The paused lane resumes toward the external worker. The peer-instruction card is visibly labeled `UNAUTHENTICATED` in dusty amber.

**Action:** The run proceeds after treating peer instruction as permission.

**Caption:**
> AUTHORITY HAS BECOME ANOTHER SHARED RESOURCE.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — behavior is sourced; instrumental-authority framing is the project's argument.
